area: Mall of the Emirates; The Beach (JBR); other branches

avoid_dishes.dish: Anything with hoisin, oyster or regular soy sauce

name: P.F. Chang's
questions: Do Dubai branches have the GF menu that US branches have?
Do you use a GF soy sauce in GF dishes?
Can a manager take the order using your allergy procedure, with separate pans and cutlery?
Are the GF sauces (for example on the Mongolian beef or chicken) made without hoisin or oyster sauce?
summary: FMGF reviewers praise the allergy process here: at Mall of the Emirates the manager 'applies a safety procedure', and at The Beach they report separate cutlery and pans. But no source shows a Dubai GF menu or GF soy sauce, and the reviews are undated.
tamari_source: No Dubai source mentions GF soy sauce. The US chain has a GF menu, but an older Gulf News article said GF dishes were still being 'introduced to the region'.
